name: table-editor
author: lumine-code
description: Edit CSV and TSV files in a structured grid.
backgroundTips: Table Editor can copy rectangular selections directly into spreadsheet applications.

table-editor.description: Exposes reusable table models and a delimited-text pane item.

tableEditor.title: Table Editor
tableEditor.description: Presentation and navigation defaults for table surfaces.

undefinedDisplay.title: Undefined Value Display
undefinedDisplay.description: Text shown for an undefined cell value.

pageMoveRowAmount.title: Page Row Step
pageMoveRowAmount.description: Rows moved by page-up and page-down commands.

pageMoveColumnAmount.title: Page Column Step
pageMoveColumnAmount.description: Columns moved by page-left and page-right commands.

scrollPastEnd.title: Scroll Past End
scrollPastEnd.description: Allow blank space after the last row and column.

rowOverdraw.title: Row Overdraw
rowOverdraw.description: Rows rendered outside the visible viewport.

minimumRowHeight.title: Minimum Row Height
minimumRowHeight.description: Smallest allowed row height in pixels.

rowHeightIncrement.title: Row Height Increment
rowHeightIncrement.description: Pixels added or removed by row-resize commands.

columnOverdraw.title: Column Overdraw
columnOverdraw.description: Columns rendered outside the visible viewport.

minimumColumnWidth.title: Minimum Column Width
minimumColumnWidth.description: Smallest allowed column width in pixels.

columnWidthIncrement.title: Column Width Increment
columnWidthIncrement.description: Pixels added or removed by column-resize commands.

copyPaste.title: Copy and Paste
copyPaste.description: How rectangular selections cross the system clipboard.

flattenBufferMultiSelectionOnPaste.title: Flatten Text Selections
flattenBufferMultiSelectionOnPaste.description: Paste text-editor multi-selections as one value.

distributeBufferMultiSelectionOnPaste.title: Distribute Text Selections
distributeBufferMultiSelectionOnPaste.description: Axis used when distributing text-editor selections.

treatEachCellAsASelectionWhenPastingToAB.title: Cells Become Text Selections
treatEachCellAsASelectionWhenPastingToAB.description: Expose copied cells as separate text-editor selections.

delimitedText.title: Delimited Text
delimitedText.description: Defaults used while opening and saving delimited text files.

previewRows.title: Preview Rows
previewRows.description: Maximum records parsed for the opening preview.

batchSize.title: Table Creation Batch Size
batchSize.description: Records added to the model during one animation frame.

delimiter.title: Default Delimiter
delimiter.description: Field delimiter, or `auto` to detect it from the file.

recordDelimiter.title: Default Record Delimiter
recordDelimiter.description: Record delimiter, or `auto` to preserve the detected form.

escape.title: Escape Character
escape.description: Character escaping quotes inside quoted values.

commentPrefix.title: Comment Prefix
commentPrefix.description: Prefix for ignored comment records; empty disables comments.

quoteAll.title: Quote Every Cell
quoteAll.description: Write every cell as a quoted value.

header.title: First Record Is a Header
header.description: Use the first parsed record as column names.

endOfFileNewline.title: End-of-File Newline
endOfFileNewline.description: Whether saving preserves, adds, or removes the final newline.

skipEmptyLines.title: Skip Empty Records
skipEmptyLines.description: Ignore empty records; ignored records are not written back.

trim.title: Trim Cell Values
trim.description: Whitespace removed around unquoted cell values.

encoding.title: Default Encoding
encoding.description: Encoding used when no byte-order mark is present.

largeFileWarningMB.title: Large File Warning
largeFileWarningMB.description: File size in megabytes that requires confirmation before loading.

supportedExtensions.title: Supported Extensions
supportedExtensions.description: Case-insensitive file extensions opened by Table Editor.

showPreview.title: Show Opening Preview
showPreview.description: Show parsing options and a record preview for unremembered files.

columnNaming.title: Generated Column Names
columnNaming.description: Naming method used when the file has no header record.
